name: Vocci
description: Vocci connects Claude to a user’s approved Vocci recordings, transcripts, AI summaries, notes, and files so captured conversations become useful working memory. Search across sessions, fetch cited source details, build concise context packs, prepare for meetings, extract decisions and action items, recover forgotten details, draft follow-ups, and turn spoken ideas into structured work through a read-only connector that returns capped, source-attributed results.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Vocci to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Vocci to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.vocci.ai/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Vocci MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Vocci provides these MCP tools: base_file_get, base_files_list, context_pack, fetch, search, session_get, and sessions_list.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Vocci?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Vocci in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
Vocci requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Vocci is developed by Vocci AI. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
